shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
My favorite season is spring because of the flowers.
I usually go for a walk after dinner each night.
Cooking new recipes is one of my favorite hobbies.
I like to travel to different countries every year.
Listening to music helps me relax after a busy day.
I often watch movies with my friends on weekends.
Maintaining a healthy lifestyle is important for everyone.
I believe that learning a new language can be very rewarding.
Volunteering in my community has brought me great joy.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your current exercise routine?

Q3: How important do you think exercise is for health?
Q4: What advice would you give someone who wants to start exercising?
